record.bible_text: Again the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, cause Jerusalem<WH03389> to know<WH03045><WTH8685> her abominations<WH08441>,

And say<WH0559><WTH8804>, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> unto Jerusalem<WH03389>; Thy birth<WH04351> and thy nativity<WH04138> <FI>is<Fi> of the land<WH0776> of Canaan<WH03669>; thy father<WH01> <FI>was<Fi> an Amorite<WH0567>, and thy mother<WH0517> an Hittite<WH02850>. <RF>birth: Heb. cutting out, or, habitation<Rf>

And <FI>as for<Fi> thy nativity<WH04138>, in the day<WH03117> thou wast born<WH03205><WTH8715> thy navel<WH08270> was not cut<WH03772><WTH8795>, neither wast thou washed<WH07364><WTH8795> in water<WH04325> to supple<WH04935> <FI>thee<Fi> ; thou wast not salted<WH04414><WTH8717> at all<WH04414><WTH8715>, nor swaddled<WH02853><WTH8795> at all<WH02853><WTH8715>. <RF>to supple...: or, when I looked upon thee<Rf>

None eye<WH05869> pitied<WH02347><WTH8804> thee, to do<WH06213><WTH8800> any<WH0259> of these unto thee, to have compassion<WH02550><WTH8800> upon thee; but thou wast cast out<WH07993><WTH8714> in the open<WH06440> field<WH07704>, to the lothing<WH01604> of thy person<WH05315>, in the day<WH03117> that thou wast born<WH03205><WTH8715>.<CM>

And when I passed<WH05674><WTH8799> by thee, and saw<WH07200><WTH8799> thee polluted<WH0947><WTH8711> in thine own blood<WH01818>, I said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto thee <FI>when thou wast<Fi> in thy blood<WH01818>, Live<WH02421><WTH8798>; yea, I said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto thee <FI>when thou wast<Fi> in thy blood<WH01818>, Live<WH02421><WTH8798>. <RF>polluted: or, trodden under foot<Rf>

I have caused<WH05414><WTH8804> thee to multiply<WH07233> as the bud<WH06780> of the field<WH07704>, and thou hast increased<WH07235><WTH8799> and waxen great<WH01431><WTH8799>, and thou art come<WH0935><WTH8799> to excellent<WH05716> ornaments<WH05716>: <FI>thy<Fi> breasts<WH07699> are fashioned<WH03559><WTH8738>, and thine hair<WH08181> is grown<WH06779><WTH8765>, whereas thou <FI>wast<Fi> naked<WH05903> and bare<WH06181>. <RF>caused...: Heb. made thee a million<Rf> <RF>excellent...: Heb. ornament of ornaments<Rf>

Now when I passed<WH05674><WTH8799> by thee, and looked<WH07200><WTH8799> upon thee, behold, thy time<WH06256> <FI>was<Fi> the time<WH06256> of love<WH01730>; and I spread<WH06566><WTH8799> my skirt<WH03671> over thee, and covered<WH03680><WTH8762> thy nakedness<WH06172>: yea, I sware<WH07650><WTH8735> unto thee, and entered<WH0935><WTH8799> into a covenant<WH01285> with thee, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, and thou becamest mine.

Then washed<WH07364><WTH8799> I thee with water<WH04325>; yea, I throughly washed away<WH07857><WTH8799> thy blood<WH01818> from thee, and I anointed<WH05480><WTH8799> thee with oil<WH08081>. <RF>blood: Heb. bloods<Rf>

I clothed<WH03847><WTH8686> thee also with broidered work<WH07553>, and shod<WH05274><WTH8799> thee with badgers' skin<WH08476>, and I girded<WH02280><WTH8799> thee about with fine linen<WH08336>, and I covered<WH03680><WTH8762> thee with silk<WH04897>.
I decked<WH05710><WTH8799> thee also with ornaments<WH05716>, and I put<WH05414><WTH8799> bracelets<WH06781> upon thy hands<WH03027>, and a chain<WH07242> on thy neck<WH01627>.

And I put<WH05414><WTH8799> a jewel<WH05141> on thy forehead<WH0639>, and earrings<WH05694> in thine ears<WH0241>, and a beautiful<WH08597> crown<WH05850> upon thine head<WH07218>. <RF>forehead: Heb. nose<Rf>

Thus wast thou decked<WH05710><WTH8799> with gold<WH02091> and silver<WH03701>; and thy raiment<WH04403> <FI>was of<Fi> fine linen<WH08336><WTH8675><WH08336>, and silk<WH04897>, and broidered work<WH07553>; thou didst eat<WH0398><WTH8804> fine flour<WH05560>, and honey<WH01706>, and oil<WH08081>: and thou wast exceeding<WH03966> beautiful<WH03302><WTH8799>, and thou didst prosper<WH06743><WTH8799> into a kingdom<WH04410>.

And thy renown<WH08034> went forth<WH03318><WTH8799> among the heathen<WH01471> for thy beauty<WH03308>: for it <FI>was<Fi> perfect<WH03632> through my comeliness<WH01926>, which I had put<WH07760><WTH8804> upon thee, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.<CM>

But thou didst trust<WH0982><WTH8799> in thine own beauty<WH03308>, and playedst the harlot<WH02181><WTH8799> because of thy renown<WH08034>, and pouredst out<WH08210><WTH8799> thy fornications<WH08457> on every one that passed by<WH05674><WTH8802>; his it was.

And of thy garments<WH0899> thou didst take<WH03947><WTH8799>, and deckedst<WH06213><WTH8799> thy high places<WH01116> with divers colours<WH02921><WTH8803>, and playedst the harlot<WH02181><WTH8799> thereupon: <FI>the like things<Fi> shall not come<WH0935><WTH8802>, neither shall it be <FI>so<Fi> .

Thou hast also taken<WH03947><WTH8799> thy fair<WH08597> jewels<WH03627> of my gold<WH02091> and of my silver<WH03701>, which I had given<WH05414><WTH8804> thee, and madest<WH06213><WTH8799> to thyself images<WH06754> of men<WH02145>, and didst commit whoredom<WH02181><WTH8799> with them, <RF>of men: Heb. of a male<Rf>

And tookest<WH03947><WTH8799> thy broidered<WH07553> garments<WH0899>, and coveredst<WH03680><WTH8762> them: and thou hast set<WH05414><WTH8804> mine oil<WH08081> and mine incense<WH07004> before<WH06440> them.

My meat<WH03899> also which I gave<WH05414><WTH8804> thee, fine flour<WH05560>, and oil<WH08081>, and honey<WH01706>, <FI>wherewith<Fi> I fed<WH0398><WTH8689> thee, thou hast even set<WH05414><WTH8804> it before<WH06440> them for a sweet<WH05207> savour<WH07381>: and <FI>thus<Fi> it was, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>. <RF>a sweet...: Heb. a savour of rest<Rf>

Moreover thou hast taken<WH03947><WTH8799> thy sons<WH01121> and thy daughters<WH01323>, whom thou hast borne<WH03205><WTH8804> unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed<WH02076><WTH8799> unto them to be devoured<WH0398><WTH8800>. <FI>Is this<Fi> of thy whoredoms<WH08457> a small matter<WH04592>, <RF>to be...: Heb. to devour<Rf>
That thou hast slain<WH07819><WTH8799> my children<WH01121>, and delivered<WH05414><WTH8799> them to cause them to pass through<WH05674><WTH8687> <FI>the fire<Fi> for them?

And in all thine abominations<WH08441> and thy whoredoms<WH08457> thou hast not remembered<WH02142><WTH8804> the days<WH03117> of thy youth<WH05271>, when thou wast naked<WH05903> and bare<WH06181>, <FI>and<Fi> wast polluted<WH0947><WTH8711> in thy blood<WH01818>.
And it came to pass after<WH0310> all thy wickedness<WH07451>, (woe<WH0188>, woe<WH0188> unto thee! saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>;)

<FI> That<Fi> thou hast also built<WH01129><WTH8799> unto thee an eminent place<WH01354>, and hast made<WH06213><WTH8799> thee an high place<WH07413> in every street<WH07339>. <RF>eminent...: or, brothel house<Rf>

Thou hast built<WH01129><WTH8804> thy high place<WH07413> at every head<WH07218> of the way<WH01870>, and hast made thy beauty<WH03308> to be abhorred<WH08581><WTH8762>, and hast opened<WH06589><WTH8762> thy feet<WH07272> to every one that passed by<WH05674><WTH8802>, and multiplied<WH07235><WTH8686> thy whoredoms<WH08457>.

Thou hast also committed fornication<WH02181><WTH8799> with the Egyptians<WH01121><WH04714> thy neighbours<WH07934>, great<WH01432> of flesh<WH01320>; and hast increased<WH07235><WTH8686> thy whoredoms<WH08457>, to provoke me to anger<WH03707><WTH8687>.

Behold, therefore I have stretched out<WH05186><WTH8804> my hand<WH03027> over thee, and have diminished<WH01639><WTH8799> thine ordinary<WH02706> <FI>food<Fi> , and delivered<WH05414><WTH8799> thee unto the will<WH05315> of them that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> thee, the daughters<WH01323> of the Philistines<WH06430>, which are ashamed<WH03637><WTH8737> of thy lewd<WH02154> way<WH01870>. <RF>daughters: or, cities<Rf>

Thou hast played the whore<WH02181><WTH8799> also with the Assyrians<WH01121><WH0804>, because<WH01115> thou wast unsatiable<WH07646><WTH8804>; yea, thou hast played the harlot<WH02181><WTH8799> with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied<WH07654>.

Thou hast moreover multiplied<WH07235><WTH8686> thy fornication<WH08457> in the land<WH0776> of Canaan<WH03667> unto Chaldea<WH03778>; and yet thou wast not satisfied<WH07646><WTH8804> herewith<WH02063>.

How weak<WH0535><WTH8802> is thine heart<WH03826>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, seeing thou doest<WH06213><WTH8800> all these <FI>things<Fi> , the work<WH04639> of an imperious<WH07986> whorish<WH02181><WTH8803> woman<WH0802>;

In that thou buildest<WH01129><WTH8800> thine eminent place<WH01354> in the head<WH07218> of every way<WH01870>, and makest<WH06213><WTH8804> thine high place<WH07413> in every street<WH07339>; and hast not been as an harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>, in that thou scornest<WH07046><WTH8763> hire<WH0868>; <RF>In that thou buildest...: or, In thy daughters is thine, etc<Rf>
<FI> But as<Fi> a wife<WH0802> that committeth adultery<WH05003><WTH8764>, <FI>which<Fi> taketh<WH03947><WTH8799> strangers<WH02114><WTH8801> instead of her husband<WH0376>!

They give<WH05414><WTH8799> gifts<WH05078> to all whores<WH02181><WTH8802>: but thou givest<WH05414><WTH8804> thy gifts<WH05083> to all thy lovers<WH0157><WTH8764>, and hirest<WH07809><WTH8799> them, that they may come<WH0935><WTH8800> unto thee on every side<WH05439> for thy whoredom<WH08457>. <RF>hirest: Heb. bribest<Rf>

And the contrary<WH02016> is in thee from <FI>other<Fi> women<WH0802> in thy whoredoms<WH08457>, whereas none followeth<WH0310> thee to commit whoredoms<WH02181><WTH8795>: and in that thou givest<WH05414><WTH8800> a reward<WH0868>, and no reward<WH0868> is given<WH05414><WTH8738> unto thee, therefore thou art<WH01961><WTH8799> contrary<WH02016>.<CM>
Wherefore, O harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>, hear<WH08085><WTH8798> the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068>:

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Because thy filthiness<WH05178> was poured out<WH08210><WTH8736>, and thy nakedness<WH06172> discovered<WH01540><WTH8735> through thy whoredoms<WH08457> with thy lovers<WH0157><WTH8764>, and with all the idols<WH01544> of thy abominations<WH08441>, and by the blood<WH01818> of thy children<WH01121>, which thou didst give<WH05414><WTH8804> unto them;

Behold, therefore I will gather<WH06908><WTH8764> all thy lovers<WH0157><WTH8764>, with whom thou hast taken pleasure<WH06149><WTH8804>, and all <FI>them<Fi> that thou hast loved<WH0157><WTH8804>, with all <FI>them<Fi> that thou hast hated<WH08130><WTH8804>; I will even gather<WH06908><WTH8765> them round about<WH05439> against thee, and will discover<WH01540><WTH8765> thy nakedness<WH06172> unto them, that they may see<WH07200><WTH8804> all thy nakedness<WH06172>.

And I will judge<WH08199><WTH8804> thee, as women that break wedlock<WH05003><WTH8802> and shed<WH08210><WTH8802> blood<WH01818> are judged<WH04941>; and I will give<WH05414><WTH8804> thee blood<WH01818> in fury<WH02534> and jealousy<WH07068>. <RF>as: Heb. with judgments of<Rf>

And I will also give<WH05414><WTH8804> thee into their hand<WH03027>, and they shall throw down<WH02040><WTH8804> thine eminent place<WH01354>, and shall break down<WH05422><WTH8765> thy high places<WH07413>: they shall strip<WH06584><WTH8689> thee also of thy clothes<WH0899>, and shall take<WH03947><WTH8804> thy fair<WH08597> jewels<WH03627>, and leave<WH03240><WTH8689> thee naked<WH05903> and bare<WH06181>. <RF>thy fair...: Heb. instruments of thine ornament<Rf>

They shall also bring up<WH05927><WTH8689> a company<WH06951> against thee, and they shall stone<WH07275><WTH8804> thee with stones<WH068>, and thrust thee through<WH01333><WTH8765> with their swords<WH02719>.

And they shall burn<WH08313><WTH8804> thine houses<WH01004> with fire<WH0784>, and execute<WH06213><WTH8804> judgments<WH08201> upon thee in the sight<WH05869> of many<WH07227> women<WH0802>: and I will cause thee to cease<WH07673><WTH8689> from playing the harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>, and thou also shalt give<WH05414><WTH8799> no hire<WH0868> any more.

So will I make my fury<WH02534> toward thee to rest<WH05117><WTH8689>, and my jealousy<WH07068> shall depart<WH05493><WTH8804> from thee, and I will be quiet<WH08252><WTH8804>, and will be no more angry<WH03707><WTH8799>.

Because thou hast not remembered<WH02142><WTH8804> the days<WH03117> of thy youth<WH05271>, but hast fretted<WH07264><WTH8799> me in all these <FI>things<Fi> ; behold<WH01887>, therefore I also will recompense<WH05414><WTH8804> thy way<WH01870> upon <FI>thine<Fi> head<WH07218>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>: and thou shalt not commit<WH06213><WTH8804> this lewdness<WH02154> above all thine abominations<WH08441>.<CM>

Behold, every one that useth proverbs<WH04911><WTH8802> shall use <FI>this<Fi> proverb<WH04911><WTH8799> against thee, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, As <FI>is<Fi> the mother<WH0517>, <FI>so is<Fi> her daughter<WH01323>.

Thou <FI>art<Fi> thy mother's<WH0517> daughter<WH01323>, that lotheth<WH01602><WTH8802> her husband<WH0376> and her children<WH01121>; and thou <FI>art<Fi> the sister<WH0269> of thy sisters<WH0269>, which lothed<WH01602><WTH8804> their husbands<WH0582> and their children<WH01121>: your mother<WH0517> <FI>was<Fi> an Hittite<WH02850>, and your father<WH01> an Amorite<WH0567>.

And thine elder<WH01419> sister<WH0269> <FI>is<Fi> Samaria<WH08111>, she and her daughters<WH01323> that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> at thy left hand<WH08040>: and thy younger<WH06996> sister<WH0269>, that dwelleth<WH03427><WTH8802> at thy right hand<WH03225>, <FI>is<Fi> Sodom<WH05467> and her daughters<WH01323>. <RF>thy younger: Heb. lesser than thou<Rf>

Yet hast thou not walked<WH01980><WTH8804> after their ways<WH01870>, nor done<WH06213><WTH8804> after their abominations<WH08441>: but, as <FI>if that were<Fi> a very<WH06985> little<WH04592><WH06962><WTH8804> <FI>thing<Fi> , thou wast corrupted<WH07843><WTH8686> more than they<WH02004> in all thy ways<WH01870>. <RF>as if...: or, that was lothed as a small thing<Rf>

<FI> As<Fi> I live<WH02416>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, Sodom<WH05467> thy sister<WH0269> hath not done<WH06213><WTH8804>, she nor her daughters<WH01323>, as thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804>, thou and thy daughters<WH01323>.

Behold, this was the iniquity<WH05771> of thy sister<WH0269> Sodom<WH05467>, pride<WH01347>, fulness<WH07653> of bread<WH03899>, and abundance<WH07962> of idleness<WH08252><WTH8687> was in her and in her daughters<WH01323>, neither did she strengthen<WH02388><WTH8689> the hand<WH03027> of the poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034>.

And they were haughty<WH01361><WTH8799>, and committed<WH06213><WTH8799> abomination<WH08441> before<WH06440> me: therefore I took them away<WH05493><WTH8686> as I saw<WH07200><WTH8804> <FI>good<Fi> .

Neither hath Samaria<WH08111> committed<WH02398><WTH8804> half<WH02677> of thy sins<WH02403>; but thou hast multiplied<WH07235><WTH8686> thine abominations<WH08441> more than they<WH02007>, and hast justified<WH06663><WTH8762> thy sisters<WH0269> in all thine abominations<WH08441> which thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804>.

Thou also, which hast judged<WH06419><WTH8765> thy sisters<WH0269>, bear<WH05375><WTH8798> thine own shame<WH03639> for thy sins<WH02403> that thou hast committed more abominable<WH08581><WTH8689> than they<WH02004>: they are more righteous<WH06663><WTH8799> than thou: yea, be thou confounded<WH0954><WTH8798> also, and bear<WH05375><WTH8798> thy shame<WH03639>, in that thou hast justified<WH06663><WTH8763> thy sisters<WH0269>.

When I shall bring again<WH07725><WTH8804> their captivity<WH07622><WTH8675><WH07622>, the captivity<WH07622><WTH8675><WH07622> of Sodom<WH05467> and her daughters<WH01323>, and the captivity<WH07622><WTH8676><WH07622> of Samaria<WH08111> and her daughters<WH01323>, then <FI>will I bring again<Fi> the captivity<WH07622><WTH8675><WH07622> of thy captives<WH07622> in the midst<WH08432> of them:

That thou mayest bear<WH05375><WTH8799> thine own shame<WH03639>, and mayest be confounded<WH03637><WTH8738> in all that thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804>, in that thou art a comfort<WH05162><WTH8763> unto them.

When thy sisters<WH0269>, Sodom<WH05467> and her daughters<WH01323>, shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> to their former estate<WH06927>, and Samaria<WH08111> and her daughters<WH01323> shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> to their former estate<WH06927>, then thou and thy daughters<WH01323> shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> to your former estate<WH06927>.

For thy sister<WH0269> Sodom<WH05467> was not mentioned<WH08052> by thy mouth<WH06310> in the day<WH03117> of thy pride<WH01347>, <RF>mentioned: Heb. for a report, or, hearing<Rf> <RF>pride: Heb. prides, or, excellencies<Rf>

Before thy wickedness<WH07451> was discovered<WH01540><WTH8735>, as at the time<WH06256> of <FI>thy<Fi> reproach<WH02781> of the daughters<WH01323> of Syria<WH0758>, and all <FI>that are<Fi> round about<WH05439> her, the daughters<WH01323> of the Philistines<WH06430>, which despise<WH07590><WTH8801> thee round about<WH05439>. <RF>Syria: Heb. Aram<Rf> <RF>despise: or, spoil<Rf>
Thou hast borne<WH05375><WTH8804> thy lewdness<WH02154> and thine abominations<WH08441>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>borne: Heb. borne them<Rf>

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; I will even deal<WH06213><WTH8804> with thee as thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804>, which hast despised<WH0959><WTH8804> the oath<WH0423> in breaking<WH06565><WTH8687> the covenant<WH01285>.<CM>

Nevertheless I will remember<WH02142><WTH8804> my covenant<WH01285> with thee in the days<WH03117> of thy youth<WH05271>, and I will establish<WH06965><WTH8689> unto thee an everlasting<WH05769> covenant<WH01285>.

Then thou shalt remember<WH02142><WTH8804> thy ways<WH01870>, and be ashamed<WH03637><WTH8738>, when thou shalt receive<WH03947><WTH8800> thy sisters<WH0269>, thine elder<WH01419> and thy younger<WH06996>: and I will give<WH05414><WTH8804> them unto thee for daughters<WH01323>, but not by thy covenant<WH01285>.
And I will establish<WH06965><WTH8689> my covenant<WH01285> with thee; and thou shalt know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>:

That thou mayest remember<WH02142><WTH8799>, and be confounded<WH0954><WTH8804>, and never open<WH06610> thy mouth<WH06310> any more because<WH06440> of thy shame<WH03639>, when I am pacified<WH03722><WTH8763> toward thee for all that thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.<CM>
